_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.

abilities.name: Stunning Fist
abilities.source: Stunning Fist (feat), Special: a monk may attempt it his monk level times a day. Declared before the attack roll (a miss ruins it); a foe the unarmed strike damages makes a Fortitude save, DC 10 + 1/2 level + Wis, or is stunned 1 round; no more than once a round. Constructs, oozes, plants, undead, incorporeal creatures and those immune to critical hits cannot be stunned. Monk class feature: from 4th he may choose fatigued instead, from 8th sickened for 1 minute, from 12th staggered for 1d6+1 rounds, from 16th blinded or deafened permanently, from 20th paralyzed for 1d6+1 rounds.
abilities.text: Your next unarmed hit this round: Fortitude save or stunned for a round.
abilities.tell: {name} gathers ki into the next blow.
not_yet: The extra use a day for every four levels in classes other than monk: the app's characters have one class.
A miss spends the use and leaves the charge until the round's end; a second unarmed hit the same round still lands it.

abilities.name: Ki Dodge
abilities.source: CRB p.58 Ki Pool: spend 1 point (swift action) for a +4 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round.
abilities.text: +4 dodge AC for a round, for 1 ki.
abilities.tell: {name} breathes out, and their body is hard to find.

abilities.name: Ki Speed
abilities.source: CRB p.58 Ki Pool: spend 1 point (swift action) to increase his speed by 20 feet for 1 round.
abilities.text: +20 ft speed for a round, for 1 ki.

abilities.name: Wholeness of Body
abilities.source: CRB p.58 Wholeness of Body: a standard action and 2 ki points heal a number of hit points equal to his monk level, to himself.
abilities.text: Heal your level in hit points, for 2 ki.
